description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Double Crystarium Mode II (Ice, Water)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Final Farseer Mode I (Noel)] and [(Ice/Water) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Final Farseer Mode I (Noel)
description.text: Ice and Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Water abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for Ice and Water abilities, casts Dual Cross Crush after every second equipped Ice or Water ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Final Farseer Mode II (Noel)], removes [Dual Awoken Final Farseer Mode I (Noel)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Final Farseer Mode II (Noel)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Ice and Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Ice and Water attacks, casts Dual Twice Down after using equipped Ice or Water abilities

description.name: Dual Twice Down
description.text: Two single ranged attacks (0.89 each), causes [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], causes [DEF -50% (8s)]/[RES -50% (8s)] every 1+2n/2+2n casts

description.name: Dual Cross Crush
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.89 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode II (Ice, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] after using a Ice/Water ability

description.name: (Ice/Water) Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Ice and Water abilities deal 5% more damage
